name: Machine Learning Materials Datasets / MAST-ML education
description: Three MIT-licensed educational tables for MAST-ML: dilute-solute diffusion, perovskite stability and adjacent metallic-glass properties. Feature rows have no atomic coordinates; source families and packaging must remain distinct.

sources.title: Machine Learning Materials Datasets Figshare v5
sources.evidence: Three educational datasets with property labels and descriptors; release is MIT licensed.

sources.title: Attached dataset README
sources.evidence: Explains normalized/raw diffusion energies, perovskite site/composition features and metallic-glass reduced transition temperature.

name: JARVIS-Tools Notebooks
description: Archived tutorial repository for electronic structure, force fields, AI and experiments; directs continued development to atomgptlab/jarvis-tools-notebooks. Inventoried README links are navigation resources, not extra dataset counts.

sources.title: Requested notebook README
sources.evidence: Lists subject-grouped materials design tutorials and its explicitly linked successor.

name: nanoHUB Machine Learning Lab Module
description: Version1.7 introductory materials-ML notebook and teaching module. Public descriptions/supporting-document list are readable; running the tool requires login. Program license is GPL3-or-later; example-data rights require separate checking.

sources.title: Public module page
sources.evidence: Public activity description identifies version1.7 and states login is required to run.

name: REMI: REsource for Materials Informatics
description: NIST pre-alpha notebook/resource index with tagged tutorials, learning resources and directly linked experimental combinatorial libraries. Owning GitHub repository is archived; directory entries are not additive datasets.

sources.title: Primary resource CSV
sources.evidence: Homepage table lists instructional notebook resources and tags.

sources.title: Open Access Data list
sources.evidence: Links experimental Fe–Co–Ni/Fe–Ga–Pd composition-spread data and major material databases.
